### Getting started
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(effectsize)
```

```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```
```{r figure out working directory}
getwd()
```

#Get general data together:
```{r}
data_chk <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/chick_cropmilkquality.csv")
key <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/keys/chick_key.csv")
# add nest type category
data_chk$type[data_chk$parental_state == "paired"] <- "paired parents"
data_chk$type[data_chk$parental_state == "single male"] <- "single parent"
data_chk$type[data_chk$parental_state == "single female"] <- "single parent"

# get brood size
data_chk <- left_join(data_chk, key, by = "nestid")
data_chk <- na.omit(data_chk)
```
# obtain average for two chick nests
```{r get average for two chick nests}
one <- data_chk[data_chk$brood == "one",]
two <- data_chk[data_chk$brood == "two",]
twoa <- two[two$chick == "a",]
twob <- two[two$chick == "b",]
two <- full_join(twoa, twob, by = "nestid")
two$crop_milk_mass_g <- (two$crop_milk_mass_g.x + two$crop_milk_mass_g.y)/2
two$color <- (two$color.x+ two$color.y)/2
two$consistency <- (two$consistency.x+ two$consistency.y)/2
two$brood <- two$brood.x
two$treatment <- two$treatment.x
two$type <- two$type.x
two <- select(two, "nestid", "brood", "crop_milk_mass_g","color","consistency", "treatment", "type")
```
# counting two-chick and one-chick broods
```{r}
twoa %>% count(treatment)
```
```{r}
one %>% count(treatment)
```
# getting data-set formatted
```{r}
data_chk_avg <- full_join(one, two)
data_chk_avg<- select(data_chk_avg, "nestid", "brood","treatment", "type", "crop_milk_mass_g","color","consistency")
# change name for treatment
data_chk_avg$treatment[data_chk_avg$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
data_chk_avg$treatment[data_chk_avg$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
data_chk_avg$treatment[data_chk_avg$treatment == "paired"] <- "paired parents"
```

###Crop content weight
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cropmilk_mass <- ggplot(aes(y = crop_milk_mass_g, x = treatment, fill=treatment), data = data_chk_avg) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) +
  labs(title = "Average weight of crop milk ingested by chicks", x="", y="crop milk weight (g)") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father", "paired parents")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = (22), textsize = 9) + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father", "single mother")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = (18), textsize = 9) + ylim(0,25) 
cropmilk_mass
```
# will remove single father outlier
```{r}
#remove outlier
data_chk_avg <- data_chk_avg[-c(15), ]
```

```{r}
leveneTest(crop_milk_mass_g ~ treatment, data = data_chk_avg, center = "mean")
```
```{r}
leveneTest(crop_milk_mass_g ~ brood, data = data_chk_avg, center = "mean")
```
#So should rank transform.
```{r}
fit_mass <- aov(rank(crop_milk_mass_g) ~ treatment+brood, data = data_chk_avg)
Anova(fit_mass, type = "II")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_mass, type = "II"))
```

```{r}
TukeyHSD(fit_mass)
```
# so significant difference between single fathered and paired parented chicks and single fathered and single mothered chicks if remove single father outlier.

# obtain effect size
```{r}
paired <- data_chk_avg[data_chk_avg$treatment == "paired parents",]
s_mom <- data_chk_avg[data_chk_avg$treatment == "single mother",]
s_fath <- data_chk_avg[data_chk_avg$treatment == "single father",]
```

# paired parented v single fathered
```{r}
p_vs_sfath <- full_join(paired, s_fath)
cohens_d(crop_milk_mass_g ~ treatment, data = p_vs_sfath)
```

# single mothered v single fathered
```{r}
smom_vs_sfath <- full_join(s_mom, s_fath)
cohens_d(crop_milk_mass_g ~ treatment, data = smom_vs_sfath)
```

# by nest type?
```{r}
leveneTest(crop_milk_mass_g ~ type, data = data_chk_avg, center = mean)
```

#still rank transform due to brood size
```{r}
fit_mass_s <- aov(rank(crop_milk_mass_g) ~ type+brood, data = data_chk_avg)
Anova(fit_mass_s, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_mass_s, type = "II"))
```
# no difference by nest type. 

### asychronous nests
```{r}
twoa$treatment[twoa$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
twoa$treatment[twoa$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
twob$treatment[twob$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
twob$treatment[twob$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
```

```{r}
asynch_a <- ggplot(aes(y = crop_milk_mass_g, x = treatment, fill=treatment), data = twoa) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(title = "Weight ingested by first-hatched chicks (two-chick nests)", x="", y="crop milk weight (g)") + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="", size = 12)) +  geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("paired parents", "single father")), map_signif_level = TRUE, y_position = c(17), textsize = 9) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) + ylim(0,22)
asynch_a
```
# removing single father outlier nest.
```{r}
#remove outliers
twoa <- twoa[-c(6), ]
```

```{r}
leveneTest(crop_milk_mass_g ~ treatment, data = twoa, center = mean)
```

```{r}
fit_a <- aov(crop_milk_mass_g ~ treatment, data = twoa)
Anova(fit_a)
```
```{r}
eta_squared(fit_a)
```
```{r}
TukeyHSD(fit_a)
```

# cohen's d
```{r}
paired <- twoa[twoa$treatment == "paired parents",]
smom <- twoa[twoa$treatment == "single mother",]
sfath <- twoa[twoa$treatment == "single father",]
```

```{r}

cohens_d(crop_milk_mass_g ~ treatment, data = sfath_vs_paired)
```

```{r}
leveneTest(crop_milk_mass_g ~ type, data = twoa, center = mean)
```

```{r}
t.test(crop_milk_mass_g ~ type, data = twoa, var.equal = TRUE)
```


### Histograms
```{r}
paired <- data_chk_avg[data_chk_avg$treatment == "paired parents",]
s_mom <- data_chk_avg[data_chk_avg$treatment == "single mother",]
s_fath <- data_chk_avg[data_chk_avg$treatment == "single father",]
```
### Color
```{r}
color_ppar <- ggplot(aes(paired$color, fill=treatment), data = paired) + stat_count(width = 0.5, color = "black") + xlim(0.5,3) + ylim(0,8) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + labs(title = "crop milk color",subtitle = "", x="", y="Count") + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none")
color_ppar
```

```{r}
color_smom <- ggplot(aes(s_mom$color, fill=treatment), data = s_mom) + stat_count(width = 0.5, color = "black") + xlim(0.5,3) + ylim(0,8) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + labs(title = "", x="", y="Count") + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none")
color_smom
```

```{r}
color_sfath <- ggplot(aes(s_fath$color, fill=treatment), data = s_fath) + stat_count(width = 0.5, color = "black") + xlim(0.5,3) + ylim(0,8) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + labs(title = "", x="crop milk color rankings", y="Count") + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none")
color_sfath
```
```{r}
tbl_color <- table(data_chk_avg$treatment, data_chk_avg$color)
tbl_color
```

```{r}
fisher.test(tbl_color, simulate.p.value = FALSE, hybrid = TRUE)
```
# effect size
```{r}
cramers_v(tbl_color)
```

# so no significant difference in crop milk color between treatment groups.

### Consistency

```{r}
consistency_ppar <- ggplot(aes(paired$consistency, fill=treatment), data = paired) + xlim(0.5,4) + ylim(0,10) + stat_count(width = 0.5, color = "black") + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + labs(title = "crop milk consistency",subtitle = "", x="", y="Count") + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "right")
consistency_ppar
```

```{r}
consistency_smom <- ggplot(aes(s_mom$consistency, fill=treatment), data = s_mom) + stat_count(width = 0.5, color = "black") + xlim(0.5,4) + ylim(0,10) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + labs(title = "", x="", y="Count") + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "right")
consistency_smom
```

```{r}
consistency_sfath <- ggplot(aes(s_fath$consistency, fill=treatment), data = s_fath) + stat_count(width = 0.5, color = "black") + xlim(0.5,4) + ylim(0,10) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + labs(title = "", x="crop milk consistency rankings", y="Count") + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "right")
consistency_sfath
```

```{r}
tbl_consistency <- table(data_chk$treatment, data_chk$consistency)
tbl_consistency
```

```{r}
fisher.test(tbl_consistency, simulate.p.value = FALSE, hybrid = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cramers_v(tbl_consistency)
```
